status: Retrospective secondary analysis of previously inspected, frozen policy/return banks; not a fresh confirmatory experiment

empirical_bernstein.source: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas (2024), Section 3.2, equations (14)-(16) of arXiv:2010.09686v5

policies: Frozen primary ridge proposal, displacement 0.05, training budget 81920; no refitting or reselection
bounds: Previously justified strongest primary support versus ordinary range, taken unchanged from certificate records
caps: Original primary cap, and 4096-pair extended research cap
alpha: Original per-comparison positive-tail level, unchanged and equal across the two tests. Results are alternative verifier replays, not a new joint familywise guarantee across tests or manuscript history.
checkpoint: Every 16 observations, and the final cap if not a multiple of 16
futility: Same-sized test on the negative contrast; label error counted separately
evaluation: Original independent evaluation stream, never used for verifier tuning
reporting: All study/test/support/cap cells, including nonadoptions; mean consumed pairs includes censored cases
synthetic: Analytic H=2 common-uniform-noise example, d in geomspace(0.005,0.5,25), alpha=0.05; compare fixed mixture and PM-EB with B=4 and B=d. Branch variances 1/3; independent contrast variance 2/3; coupled contrast variance zero. No learned-policy claim.
tuning: No sweep of lambda caps, stopping thresholds, policies, or return order
